title: Ten, Eleven, Twelve, and the au Sign
label: ch:mr-ten-to-twelve
canDo: I can count to twelve, hear the worn-down ten at the end of the teens, and write the au vowel sign.

payoff.summary: Complete MR-R56-ten-to-twelve and count to twelve, then name the worn-down dahaa hiding at the end of akraa and baaraa.
payoff.note: The au vowel sign is here rather than with its ai partner because chapter 57's chaudaa cannot be written without it and nothing else in the book needs ai yet.
